flags.why: The archaic tag misleadingly marks a term still used in modern traditional medicine as obsolete ([hospital explanation](https://bvnguyentriphuong.com.vn/y-hoc-co-truyen/chan-mach-la-gi)).
Chẩn mạch means examining the pulse for diagnosis and does not imply diagnosing from the pulse alone ([hospital explanation](https://bvnguyentriphuong.com.vn/y-hoc-co-truyen/chan-mach-la-gi)).
flags.fix: Merge with sense 1: to examine a patient's pulse for diagnosis, especially in traditional medicine.

flags.why: This is the ordinary 'not worth the effort' use of chẳng bõ, so tagging it rare falsely distinguishes it from sense 1 ([dictionary definition](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-ch%E1%BA%B3ng%20b%C3%B5)).
